entities.summary: Juan Jose Graterol Montevideo is a Venezuelan former professional baseball catcher who currently serves as a strategist and bullpen catcher for the Kansas City Royals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Los Angeles Angels, Minnesota Twins, and Cincinnati Reds.
